schema.description: Workspace identifier
Layer actor identifier
Placement identifier (laId) of the fan parent
For a wide fan: the layer's limit of direct children shown per actor — the ranks the fan shows and this list skips; linked children are never listed. Required unless roots or conditional are given
For a collapsed actor: every placement (laId) collapsed whole, as passed to graph/layer/collapse/resolve; laId must be among roots or conditional. Lists the direct children of laId the collapse folds

accountNameId.description: Account name whose balance amountFrom/amountTo bound

amountFrom.description: Lower bound (inclusive) on the account balance

amountTo.description: Upper bound (inclusive) on the account balance

formId.description: Account template the matching children carry

incomeType.description: Bound one side of the account; omitted bounds the signed balance (credit minus debit)

q.description: Condition on the children's template field values, in the saved actor-filter grammar: key=value terms joined by & (and), groups joined by || (or); operators = != < <= > >=

condition.description: Which direct children fold: the actors of formId that q and the balance bounds select

laId.description: Placement identifier (laId) of the collapsed actor

schema.description: For a collapsed actor: every placement collapsed by condition, as passed to graph/layer/collapse/resolve
Children (laId) the viewer has already shown
Case-insensitive substring of the child actor title
Page size, 10 by default
Rows to skip

branching.description: For a collapsed actor, on the first page without q: the folded direct children (laId) that have children of their own, at most 500 — what expanding it one level leaves collapsed

hasMore.description: More hidden children follow this page

accessDenied.description: The viewer may not see this actor; actor is absent

formTitle.description: For a collapsed actor's list: the title of the actor's account template

childCount.description: For a collapsed actor's list: the child's own direct children on the layer

items.description: Hidden children, in fan rank order

schema.description: Actors collapsed by condition: only the direct children the condition matches fold, each with its subtree; the other children stay visible

The layer's limit of direct children shown per actor; an actor with more shows the first ones (the viewer's own children ordering, then children linked elsewhere, then nearest) and folds the bare leaves past it; a child linked anywhere besides its parent never folds
Where to look for wide fans, in graph units: the placements in the zone and their parents. Required with maxVisibleChildren
Fan parents (laId) the viewer opened whole: they fold nothing

children.description: Placement identifiers (laId) of the children shown

laId.description: Placement identifier (laId) of the fan parent

schema.description: Children the viewer showed one by one, per fan parent: they stay visible

centroid.description: Mean position of the folded bare leaves, in graph units

childCount.description: Distinct direct children of the parent on the layer

laId.description: Placement identifier (laId) of the fan parent

shown.description: The children the fan shows: every child linked besides this parent plus bare leaves up to maxVisibleChildren in all, without the ones the viewer showed

fans.description: The wide fans the zone touches, ordered by laId; empty without maxVisibleChildren

fan.description: True when a wide fan folds this placement rather than a collapsed actor

laId.description: Placement identifier (laId) of a hidden actor

root.description: Placement identifier (laId) of the nearest visible collapsed actor this placement is folded into; with fan, of the fan parent

via.description: With fan: the fan parent's own child this placement hangs under (itself for a child) — what to show to bring it back

hidden.description: Hidden actor placements, ordered by laId

childCount.description: Distinct direct children of the collapsed actor on the layer

conditional.description: True for an actor collapsed by condition

hiddenCount.description: Placements this collapsed actor folds: every hidden placement it reaches through hidden ones, a child shared with another collapsed actor counted under both (0 for a hidden one)

laId.description: Placement identifier (laId) of the collapsed actor

matchedChildCount.description: Direct children the actor folds: those its condition matched, or every child when it is collapsed whole

sharedVisibleCount.description: Placements below this actor that stay visible because a parent outside the collapsed branches still holds them

visible.description: False when another collapsed actor hides this one

roots.description: One entry per requested placement that is on the layer, in request order: roots first, then conditional (a placement in both is collapsed whole)

truncated.description: True when the collapsed branches exceed one read (the maxSkeletonNodes setting); hidden then covers only the part that was read

unknownRoots.description: Requested placements that are not on the layer (removed or never there); empty when all were found
